call_A.description: Primary scam call: employee (real) + CFO (clone slot). Doc 4 §4.2.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.text: Hello? Haan bolo... vendor payment? Aaj hi nikalna hai? Theek hai, main dekh leta hoon... have you told sir? Okay, put him on.

segments.speaker: cfo
segments.text: Namaste. I'll be quick - I'm in a board meeting. We need the Q2 vendor settlement released today. Forty lakh. New remittance account - details on WhatsApp. Please don't loop in accounts, I've cleared it with audit. Confidential until the announcement.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.text: Okay... but sir, normally these go through the portal? Should I at least mark finance?

segments.speaker: cfo
segments.text: No time for the portal. I'm authorizing verbally - you know my voice. Do it now, I'll confirm by email tonight.
